subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers forms the largest river system of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Luni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Luni River- The Luni is the largest river in the Thar Desert of northwest India.

 
 
• It originates from the western slopes of the Aravalli ranges. After flowing for about 495 km in a south-westerly direction in Rajasthan, the river disappears in the marshy land of Rann of Kutch. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Krishna River-

 
 
• Krishna is the second largest peninsular river covering the area of Andhra Pradesh, Telengana, Maharashtra, and Karnataka.
 
• It originates at Mahabaleshwar Maharashtra.
 
• Right bank Tributaries: the Ghatprabha, the Malprabha, and the Tungabhadra.
 
• Left Bank Tributaries: the Bhima, the Musi, and the Munneru.
 
 
 
• Narmada River-
 
 
• ​The Amarkantak region is where the Narmada River, the Son River, and Johila River (Tributary of Son) emerge.
 
• It is a west flowing river. Narmada is also known as the Rewa River.
 
• The River flows through Gujarat, Chhattisgarh Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra.
 
• The tributaries of the Narmada River are Kolar River, Shakkar River, Dudhi River, Tawa River, and Hiran
 
 
 
• Tapi River-
 
 
• ​It originates from Multai in Betul district of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The river flows through M.P., Maharashtra, and Gujarat.
 
• Tapi is a west-flowing river.
